Oral Cancer Screening at Clearwater, FL

BOOK NOW

We Perform Thorough Oral Pathology Exams

At Clearwater Dentist, we take your wellbeing seriously by offering cutting-edge oral pathology and cancer screenings designed to detect diseases of the mouth, jaw, and related structures early enough for intervention and early diagnosis.

 

Only one-third of oral cancers are detected at an effective stage for treatment, underlining the importance of routine screenings. Furthermore, many diseases, including oral cancer, often manifest without notice or discomfort - necessitating professional evaluation as soon as symptoms emerge. Our team at Oral Pathology Specialists in Clearwater FL excel at recognizing potential abnormalities while conducting comprehensive examinations that include x-rays of your mouth, head and neck to thoroughly assess lesions based on factors like color shape size location texture etc.

 

Should any troubling findings arise, our gentle dental laser will perform minimally invasive biopsies using minimally invasive techniques to screen for cancer or other diseases and make treatment decisions accordingly. Your health and safety are always of utmost concern to us and we aim to offer thorough and compassionate care designed to safeguard both oral and overall wellbeing.

Oral Pathology Signs To Check

  • Red or white patches in the mouth
  • Bleeding sores in the mouth
  • Lumps developing within the mouth
  • Constant sore throat or difficulty swallowing

Prevention Begins At Home

If a biopsy taken comes back as something dangerous, we will take the necessary steps to help eliminate the concern and restore your oral health. Dr. Nadia Pokrovskaya recommends her patients start at-home oral cancer screenings to help identify potential concerns early. If you notice anything suspicious like lumps, pain, or discoloration, it should be addressed right away by scheduling an appointment with Dr. Pokrovskaya.
